description: The non-negative integer power of a 2 by 2 integer matrix. The exponent 0 is the identity [1, 0, 0, 1]. [1, 1, 0, 1] to the fifth is [1, 5, 0, 1]. [1, 1, 1, 0] to the fifth is [8, 5, 5, 3]. The exponent runs from 0 to 64. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sl2-pow
